rationale: All 8 start runs are feasible with wide margins (hold ≥ +0.08 ns, 0 DRC, ≤18 slew/cap pins vs bar 89), so only T_eff matters. Loose targets (9.3–9.8 ns) stall at T_eff ~6 ns; targets near 5 ns give 4.67–4.81 with positive slack (+0.30/+0.23), so tighten: pin period_frac 0.46 (4.6 ns). The two best runs (md5, bm64) share timing-driven placement, synthesis sizing, post-GRT design repair and no routability mode; the DELAY 4 run without timing-driven placement or sizing failed badly (7.78). Keep the best run's AREA 3, cap213 wire model (signoff-calibrated estimates) and post-GRT timing repair, useful at tight targets. Leave utilisation, density, margins, ABC buffering and repair percentages to the optimizer.
